triples.tail_surface: review of asset sub-assemblies and components to identify failure modes followed by their causes and effects
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 资产子组件和部件审查以识别故障模式及其原因和后果
triples.evidence_text: Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA). This process is a review of asset sub-assemblies and components to identify failure modes followed by their causes and effects.

triples.tail_surface: Remediation tasks are developed where non-disruptive predictive technologies are to be applied as the primary option
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 制定补救任务并优先应用非干扰性预测技术
triples.evidence_text: Remediation tasks are developed where non-disruptive predictive technologies are to be applied as the primary option.

triples.tail_surface: reviews all previous asset maintenance and performance records with the objective to reaffirm or select replacement value added maintenance tasks
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 审查以往资产维护和性能记录以确认或选择增值维护任务
triples.evidence_text: Maintenance Task Analysis (MTA). This process reviews all previous asset maintenance and performance records with the objective to reaffirm or select replacement value added maintenance tasks.

triples.tail_surface: Tasks are then revised or replaced based on the consequence and feasibility of the tasks to remedy or monitor the failure mode
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 根据补救或监测故障模式的后果和可行性修订或更换任务
triples.evidence_text: Tasks are then revised or replaced based on the consequence and feasibility of the tasks to remedy or monitor the failure mode.

triples.tail_surface: allows the asset to operate until a failure occurs followed by replacement of the failed component(s)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 允许资产运行至故障发生后更换故障部件
triples.evidence_text: Run to Failure (RTF). This strategy allows the asset to operate until a failure occurs followed by replacement of the failed component(s).
